objective: No upgrade pads: a basic ranch menu opened at the Ranch House door. Bought eggs go to an egg storage; the player chooses which to hatch (six at once), eggs take time, and a finished egg is opened by interacting with it. The hub's egg stands are replaced by an egg vendor and a gear vendor on every ranch.
acceptance_criteria: Buying an egg puts it in the egg storage: it is not hatching and no animal is added
Only the egg the player chooses starts hatching, at most six at once; nothing starts or opens by itself
A finished egg opens only when asked and only with room in the Barn; an unfinished or stored egg is refused
The client never receives the animal inside an egg
In Studio play there are no upgrade pads or hub egg stands; the house door, the egg storage, a finished egg and the two vendors each respond to their prompt
